notes.title: Patch #9 - New Scenario and Scenario Changes, Bugfixes, Misc. Changes
notes.content:
[h2]Changes to Scenarios : [/h2]

[list]
[*] New scenario was added - "Island Assault". It is a straightforward scenario, showcasing simple combat on favorable terms, including a naval invasion of a small island. 
[*] Scenario icons were updated to reflect changes made.
[*] Scenarios were remade in order to not include unnecessary resources and properly showcase real population.
[*] Dragon Hunt scenario was reclassified to medium difficulty, while Relief was upgrade to the hard difficulty to address the real challenge difference for players.
[/list]

[h2]Bugfixes :[/h2]

[list]
[*] A rare bug where an AI enemy sometimes manages to move out of turn on unit death was fixed.
[*] Fixed potential crashes due to AI
[*] Fixed fog of war sometimes being incorrectly loaded in in scenarios.
[*] Fixed population incorrectly being displayed as negative in scenarios.
[*] Fixed 3 digit hitpoints displaying incorrectly in unit details.
[*] Fixed a visual issue where negative income was incorrectly displayed with double negative signs.
[/list]
[h2]Miscellaneous Changes : [/h2]

[list]
[*] Battering Ram speed was changed  (8 -> 5) due to it being definitely too fast for a siege weapon.
[*] Removed excess information on playerslots in multiplayer games.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch #8 - Bugfixes, camera changes, miscellaneous improvements.
notes.content:
[h2]Bugfixes:[/h2]

[list]
[*] Fixed a major multiplayer issue where nature (wolves on random custom maps) would take a turn on each players turn, making them much stronger than intended in most cases.
[*] Fixed berry bushes being extracted before combat, if enemy unit is standing on berry bushes.
[/list]

[h2]Camera changes:[/h2]

[list]
[*] Increase maximum zoom, to allow for easier navigation on larger maps.
[*] Increased maximum interaction range to allow for clicking units that are much further away.
[/list]

[h2]Miscellaneous changes:[/h2]

[list]
[*] Editor Save/Load UI was updated.
[*] Minor UI improvements were implemented in various places in the game
[*] A new trailer was uploaded into our store page!
[/list]

notes.title: Patch #7 - Integrated bug reporting, new special unit, misc. improvements
notes.content:
Hello!
This small patch includes a minor content update, and few minor improvements.
Here are the details.

[h2]Bug Reporting [/h2]

[list]
[*] added bug reporter into the game, accesible from the main menu, and gameover screen, which relays bug reports into our development discord server.
[/list]
Previously we encouraged giving us feedback via e-mail or through our discord server, but we understand this is rather cumbersome for some people. That's why the bug reporter was added to the main menu, and game end screen, which is integrated into our development discord server. 

[h2]New scenario unit with a unique function - King[/h2]

[list]
[*] Added King as a scenario-only unit, that prevents defeat when alive.
[*] Replaced Pioneers in the Skirmish challenge with the King, to better suit the envisioned flow of the scenario.
[/list]
We decided to add a new unit, representing the monarch ruling your realm. A player with an alive monarch will never be defeated, even upon losing his cities. This lets you create scenarios without being constrained to city centers or pioneers. Scenarios where a pioneer has been so far used for this purpose were updated accordingly.
In the future, King will be included as one of the potential victory conditions in the main game, if the appropriate game mode is chosen.

[h3]Miscellaneous additions:[/h3]

[list]
[*] Store page assets were updated
[*] Minor UI adjustments have been applied.
[*] Game logo has been updated.
[/list]
Library assets along with store and logo, have been updated to give off a more fresh look. Additionally some in game UI tweaks have been applied for increased readability.

notes.title: The Forces of Nature - Update 0.2
notes.content: [p]Hello again![/p][p][/p][p align="start"]As promised, we present you the first major update to Ascendant Realms![/p][p]A big thank you to everyone participating in the beta testing of this update![/p][p]Since the last announcement, thanks to your feedback, we managed to include some additional changes and features in the update, that weren't in the original announcment.[/p][p]But let us not delay, here is the full changelog of the 0.2 Update. [/p][p align="start"][/p][h1][b]Steam Multiplayer[/b][/h1][p align="start"]Long overdue, online multiplayer through steam is finally here! We hope this makes it much easier for you connect with your friends when playing.[/p][list][*][p]You can now switch between multiplayer through Steam, and LAN with default being Steam.[/p][/*][*][p]You can invite and join your friends through you steam friends.[/p][/*][/list][h1][b]Wilderness Update[/b][/h1][p align="start"]Heading over to the content update, there are quite a few new changes to core gameplay that will surely spice up both early and late game.[/p][list][*][p]Added new terrain types, hill along with its visual natural object, as well as a few extra terrains for the editor, including two types of roads, which grant extra movement speed.[/p][/*][*][p]Added a new neutral faction, representing wild animals and beasts (and in the future banditry!) who are always hostile, to any player in the game.[/p][/*][*][p]Collecting berry bushes for extra early game food is now no longer a free-action, and will use up the movement for your builders.[/p][/*][*][p]Previously useless sand/beach terrain can now support fortress as a building, enabling you to construct a solid coastal defense and cover up the gaps in your fortifications.[/p][/*][*][p]Hills, trees and other vegetation now populate the valleys, that big mountain ranges have been carved out of the previously large mountain ranges.[/p][/*][/list][h3]Wolves[/h3][list][*][p]Alongside the neutral faction, wolves were now added to the game as early game threat, that makes you think twice before exploring boldly with your builders![/p][/*][*][p]Wolves now have an updated model, compared to their previous editor-only appearance.[/p][/*][*][p]Wolves have slightly reduced base damage(5->4), but retain their bonus damage versus builders.[/p][/*][/list][h3]Dragons[/h3][p align="start"]Yes, you read that right. In this update you'll be able to face those legendary beasts as part of some challenge scenarios included![/p][p align="start"]These massive behemoths will truly test the resolve of your soldiers, and challenge your strategic sense, as you face them in open field.[/p][h2]General Improvements[/h2][p align="start"]Aside from the general content updates. A considerable amount of much needed improvements will be included. Some of these include:[/p][list][*][p]UI has been completely visually revamped in order to provide a much cleaner and more readable look.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]fixed a multiplayer issue with host sometimes receiving a wrong amount of resources in a game with AI, after the AI is defeated.[/p][/*][*][p]fixed visual inconsistencies with resource display that sometimes occur when playing on multiplayer.[/p][/*][*][p]fixed an issue when loading saved gamed/scenarios in which the number of player isn't correctly read from the file.[/p][/*][*][p]fixed an editor issue with buildings not loading in properly in the editor, when the map is being loaded from a file.[/p][/*][*][p]and many more, including editor fixes and visual glitches...[/p][/*][/list][h2]Balance Changes[/h2][p align="start"]Some minor balance changes will also be introduced, in order to better account for the introduced content. Note that some of these may vary in the final update. These include but are not limited to:[/p][list][*][p]wolf base damage has been reduced from 5 to 4[/p][/*][*][p]wolves will no longer attack buildings (unless there is a tasty builder hiding inside)[/p][/*][*][p]reduced speed of light cavalry from 8 to 7[/p][/*][*][p]mountain movement cost has been increased from 5 to 8 to make them virtually impossible to move through, as their lower altitude hill counterpart, is now introduced.[/p][/*][*][p]spearman now has considerable bonus damage versus wolves, to make them more viable in early army compositions.[/p][/*][*][p]compared to the beta build, wolf minimum spawn distance is significantly raised (from 5 to 8 tiles minimum from any player)[/p][/*][/list][h2]Bug Fixes / Minor Improvements[/h2][list][*][p]fixed an editor issue, where building would not be properly loaded when loading a scenario[/p][/*][*][p]fixed a multiplayer specific issue where scenario settings sometimes would not be properly shared through the lobby causing a potential desync[/p][/*][*][p]fixed a save loading issue, which caused the scenarios to not properly load game config from file[/p][/*][*][p]replaced old icons in the editor, that were mistakenly left behind[/p][/*][*][p]some descriptions were slightly rewritten to provide more clarity[/p][/*][*][p]many new town names were added[/p][/*][*][p]fixed a multiplayer specific issue which caused the wolves to appear as pioneers in the first turn for everyone but the host[/p][/*][*][p]fixed the potential issue with unfair host advantage in a case where a multiplayer game is played with several players and ai's.[/p][/*][*][p]context tech info-panel will now always dissapear when leaving the tech menu[/p][/*][*][p]our twitter and discord is now accesible from the main menu![/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]We hope you enjoy! And please let us know what you think of this update![/p]

notes.title: Patch #6 - Visuals, Editor Content, Balance, AI improvements, QoL, Bugfixes
notes.content:
[b]Visual Changes:[/b]

[list]
[*] Replaced the model for the iron mine, to resemble an ore vein more, with some chunks of iron embedded.
[*] Several textures were updated to better fit the low poly style of the game.
[/list]

[b]Editor Content:[/b]

[list]
[*] New scenario-exclusive(for now) Wolf was added as a unit. It's a quick high damage unit strong versus civilians but vulnerable to military units.
[*] Added brick road and dirt road tiles as scenario-exclusive tiles. These can be used to speed up travel with brick road having half the movement cost of an empty green tile, and dirt road having 3/4 of the movement cost. 
[/list]

[b]AI Improvements:[/b]

[list]
[*] AI is now much more effective at attacking enemy buildings, and way more aggressive in its attacks.
[*] AI will now much more effectively search for valid starting point, were it to start in an obstructed tile.
[/list]

[b]Balance Changes:[/b]

[list]
[*] Reduced the time to research settlements from 2 to 1 turn to shorten the time required to start setting up mid-game economy. To compensate for this speed-up the following two changes were made. 
[*] Reduced amount of population each settlement gives 3 -> 2
[*] Reduced amount of gold adjacency bonus of a Townhall 3 -> 2
[/list]

[b]Quality Of Life:[/b]

[list]
[*] When attempting to place a Townhall in invalid position, an error message will now be shown to avoid confusion
[*] It will be no longer possible to set up a Townhall on sand to avoid inconsistency.
[/list]

[b]Bugfixes:[/b]

[list]
[*] Fixed an issue with population sometimes displaying double its intended value in between turns.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch #5 - Quality of Life, Bugfixes, Editor improvements, Balance
notes.content:
[b]Quality of life:[/b]

[list]
[*] In multiplayer games, a sound now plays whenever your turn comes up.
[*] In the game lobby, you may now pick from the list of saves instead of manully writing the save games name in order to load it.
[/list]
[b]Bugfixes:[/b]

[list]
[*] Fixed an editor issue, where a color of a placed building would not be displayed in the editor itself.
[*] Fixed an editor issue, where a placed city center would display City_Name as it's name instead of an actual name.
[*] Fixed an editor issue, where a building could be incorrectly saved with 0 hp.
[*] Fixed a save issue, where technologies would not be properly restored after loading. (your saved games will still work after this change)
[/list]
[b]Editor Improvements:[/b]

[list]
[*] In editor you may now remove all objects from a given tile by right clicking on it, which should help improve the pace of map design.
[/list]
[b]Balance changes:[/b]

[list]
[*] Hunting Camp hp reduced from 20 -> 15 in order to reduce its viability as a blocker.
[*] Barracks now cost an additional 50 gold aside from usual wood cost.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch #4 - Save System, Bugfixes
notes.content:
[b]Saving and loading:[/b]
[list]
[*] Game can be saved at any time via the in game menu, and function similarly as scenarios. This works both in singleplayer and multiplayer.
[*] Scenario/save location is now within the game files in the Saves catalogue.
[/list]
[b]Bugfixes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue with fog of war being incorrectly shown in multiplayer while processing turn.
[*] Fixed an issue with negative resource income not being shown correctly.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch #3 - Map Generation Changes, Optimization, Bugfixes
notes.content:
[b]Changes to the map generation :
[/b]

[list]
[*] To improve accessibility on tighter maps, large mountain ranges will now be broken into valleys and smaller clusters, forming natural paths between them and allowing for easier access to different parts of the map.
[*] The Oceanic map type has been reworked to more consistently spawn islands and avoid situations where mountain ranges render them unusable. Islands are now also slightly larger than before.
[*] The Mountainous map type has been adjusted to rarely contain bodies of water, emphasizing its intended gameplay focus.
[*] The Default map type now features slightly less water, resulting in a more balanced and navigable landscape.
[/list]

[b]Optimization:[/b]

Larger maps were previously quite demanding. This update introduces a range of optimizations aimed at improving performance. As a result, you may see significant performance gains on large maps potentially up to 2 times higher frame rates in some cases.

[b]Bugfixes :[/b]

[list]
[*]Fixed an issue with the hunting camp displaying incorrect amount of trees on its model.
[*]Corrected the swordsman's tech assignment, which previously allowed it to be unlocked from an unintended tech path.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch #2 - Balance Changes, Bugfixes, Visual update
notes.content:
[b]Balance Changes:[/b]

Gold production has been adjusted to encourage the production of luxury goods. Previously, sufficient gold production could be achieved with too few cities and settlements. 

[list]
[*] Townhall's settlement adjacency bonus has been reduced from 5 to 3
[*] Settlement gold production has been decreased from 5 to 3
[*] Settlements built adjacent to other settlements now provide a bonus yield of 1 gold instead of 2
[/list]

[b]Visual improvements:[/b]
[list]
[*] Several sprites have been replaced with refined versions
[/list]

[b]Bugfixes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Luxury goods incorrectly display their income.
[*] Sometimes building foundations(in-construction models) are left over when they are destroyed by a ranged attack
[*] Natural objects (trees, iron mines) missing after a production building on which they were built is destroyed.
[*] Units in a transport ship could be overwritten by attempting to load another unit.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch #1 - Tutorial Overhaul + Bug Fixes
notes.content:
The tutorial has been completely reworked to provide a more intuitive and engaging introduction to the game:

[list]
[*]The original single wall of text has been replaced with a multi-page format that guides you step-by-step through various aspects of the game.
[*]Key concepts are now highlighted with color accents to improve clarity.
[*]Looping video visualizations have been added to demonstrate core mechanics in action.
[*]The scope of the tutorial has been expanded to cover more essential aspects of the game.
[/list]

Additionally, some minor bug fixes have been implemented:

[list]
[*]Game summary now correctly resets game statistics between playthroughs.
[*]Fixed minor visual glitches in the in-game menu.
[/list]
